answer: The beacon graph is validated at intake and the delta frontier is published, and hence the ancestry of every answer is public, and haven anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The arithmetic runs against the attacker: 528 aliases cost 526 times the entry price, and a 19 day hold keeps that capital locked for the whole attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
